accounts.about.automatic_text: A new version is downloaded in the background, checked against the project's signature, and installed the next time the application starts.
accounts.about.folder_home: the Applications folder of your home folder
accounts.about.independent: An independent, open-source client. Not affiliated with WhatsApp.
accounts.about.interrupt.messages.one: 1 message is still on its way out
accounts.about.interrupt.messages.other: {n} messages are still on their way out
accounts.about.interrupt.text: {busy}. Messages that are waiting are kept and sent after the restart; a recording that was not sent is lost.
accounts.about.interrupt.voice: a voice note is being recorded
accounts.about.move_explain: Where it was opened from, {name} cannot replace itself with a new version. In {folder} it updates by itself.
accounts.about.move_failed: {name} could not be moved: {why}. Nothing was changed.
accounts.about.move_offer: Move {name} to {folder}? From there it updates by itself.
accounts.about.source_default: Updates come from the project's releases.
accounts.about.source_explain: Updates come from the project's releases. Another address (https) can be a mirror; it must serve the same signed files.
accounts.about.source_saved: Saved. Updates are taken from this address.
accounts.about.source_this: Updates are taken from this address.
accounts.connection.back: Messages you send will go out when it is back.
accounts.connection.logged_out_sentence: This number was logged out. Link it again.
accounts.connection.logged_out_waiting: This number was logged out. Messages you send will go out once it is linked again.
accounts.connection.reason.free_limit_re: the free plan's limit was reached
accounts.connection.reason.link_timeout: it was not linked in time
accounts.connection.reason.logged_out: it was logged out on the phone
accounts.connection.reason.session_not_f: its session no longer exists on the server
accounts.connection.unlinked_sentence: This number was created and never linked to a phone.
accounts.connection.unlinked_waiting: This number is not linked yet. Messages you send will go out once it is linked.
accounts.library.animate: Animate stickers and GIFs on hover
accounts.library.animate_text: In the picker, the one tile the pointer or the keyboard is on moves; the rest stay still. Reduced motion (Appearance) keeps everything still.
accounts.library.key_help: Get a key at developers.giphy.com. It is kept in the system keychain, never in the settings file, and no key comes with this application.
accounts.library.key_refused: The keychain did not take the key: {error}
accounts.library.key_saved: Key saved in the system keychain.
accounts.library.key_saved_state: A key is saved in the system keychain.
accounts.library.online_text: Off by default. Searches are sent to Giphy (api.giphy.com), a third party, with your own API key and the words you type, and the GIFs you pick are downloaded from it. Nothing is sent to anyone while this is off.
accounts.library.summary: {stickers} stickers and {gifs} GIFs, {size} of {budget} MB. {favorites} favorites are never removed; when the library is full, what was used longest ago goes first.
accounts.library.your_library_text: Stickers and GIFs you keep, in the encrypted database on this computer. Signing out deletes them with the rest.
accounts.linking.code_step.open: On the phone, open WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link a device.
accounts.linking.finishing.text: The phone accepted. This takes a few seconds.
accounts.linking.finishing.title: Finishing
accounts.linking.linked.title: Linked
accounts.linking.phone_error.empty: Type the number to link, with its country code.
accounts.linking.phone_error.long: That number is too long: a phone number has at most 15 digits.
accounts.linking.phone_error.not_digits: A phone number has only digits, after the + of its country code.
accounts.linking.phone_error.short: That number is too short. Include the country code: +58 412 123 4567.
accounts.linking.phone_error.zeros: Start with the country code, without zeros in front: +58 412 123 4567.
accounts.linking.scan.text: On the phone: WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link a device. The code refreshes by itself.
accounts.linking.scan.title: Scan this code with the phone
accounts.linking.starting.text: The code appears here in a few seconds.
accounts.linking.starting.title: Starting the session
accounts.linking.stopped.title: Linking stopped
accounts.linking.type_code.text: On the phone: WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link a device > Link with phone number instead.
accounts.linking.type_code.title: Type this code on the phone
accounts.login.approve_text: Open wuapi in the browser and confirm that it shows this code.
accounts.login.denied_text: The request was denied in the browser. If that was not you, there is nothing else to do: no key was issued.
accounts.login.expired_text: Nobody approved it in time. A new code takes a second.
accounts.login.key_not_saved_text: This session works. The API key could not be saved, so you will be asked to sign in again the next time you start.
accounts.login.keychain_advice_linux: You can still sign in, but the API key cannot be saved and you will be asked again at every start. To fix it, install and unlock a Secret Service keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet), then restart. On a machine without one, start with WUAPI_API_KEY set instead.
accounts.login.keychain_advice_other: You can still sign in, but the API key cannot be saved and you will be asked again at every start. Unlock the system keychain and restart, or start with WUAPI_API_KEY set instead.
accounts.login.keychain_title: The system keychain is not available
accounts.login.no_browser: No browser on this computer? Open {uri} on any device and type the code.
accounts.login.offline_text: Check your connection. Nothing was lost; try again when you are back online.
accounts.login.start_text: It reaches WhatsApp through your wuapi account. You approve this computer in the browser; no password or API key is typed here.
accounts.numbers.choose_place: Choose where the number connects from.
accounts.numbers.cloud_always_on: Always on: messages arrive with this computer off
accounts.numbers.cloud_favourites: Sticker favourites and status privacy, as on the phone
accounts.numbers.cloud_places_failed: Wuapi Cloud's places could not be loaded. Close this and try again in a moment.
accounts.numbers.cloud_team: One number for the whole team, on every computer
accounts.numbers.code_coming: The code is on its way.
accounts.numbers.code_intro: WhatsApp gives a code for this number. You type it on the phone and nothing has to be scanned.
accounts.numbers.connection_dropped: The connection dropped. Still waiting for the phone.
accounts.numbers.delete_failed: The number could not be deleted. {why}
accounts.numbers.done_text: Its chats appear as they arrive. Imported history can take a few minutes.
accounts.numbers.history_next: It applies to the next link: to import now, log this number out and link it again from the phone.
accounts.numbers.history_off: History: not imported. Chats from before this number was linked are not here, because WhatsApp only hands them over at the moment of linking.
accounts.numbers.history_recent: History: the phone's recent chats are imported when this number links.
accounts.numbers.import_history: Import recent chats from the phone
accounts.numbers.import_history_text: WhatsApp hands its history over once, when the number links. It cannot be asked for later.
accounts.numbers.local_while_open: Connected only while this application is open
accounts.numbers.log_out_text: {name} will be unlinked from its phone and stop sending and receiving. The number and its messages stay; to use it again it has to be linked again from the phone.
accounts.numbers.method_code_text: You type an 8-character code on the phone.
accounts.numbers.method_qr_text: The phone's camera reads a code shown here.
accounts.numbers.not_linked_in_time: The number was not linked in time.
accounts.numbers.phone_hint_code: With its country code, like +58 412 123 4567. Once the code is asked for, this number links with the code.
accounts.numbers.place_hint: The number reaches WhatsApp from here. Its own country is the best choice.
accounts.numbers.places_failed: The list of places could not be loaded. {why}
accounts.numbers.places_loading: Loading the places a number can connect from…
accounts.numbers.qr_unreadable: The code could not be drawn. A new one is on its way.
accounts.numbers.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
accounts.numbers.rate_limited_in: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
accounts.numbers.remove_text: {name} was created and never linked to a phone, so it holds no chats. Removing it deletes it for good.
accounts.numbers.stop_linking: Stop linking? This number was created just now and never linked, so deleting it loses nothing. Keeping it leaves it in Settings to link later.
accounts.numbers.unreachable: Could not reach the provider. Try again.
accounts.onboarding.cloud_text: A number linked on this computer only works while this application is open. With Wuapi Cloud it stays connected when the computer is off, and a team shares the same numbers.
accounts.onboarding.line_link: {name} is a WhatsApp client for this computer. Link a number to see its chats here.
accounts.onboarding.line_no_link: {name} is a WhatsApp client for this computer. There is no number yet, and this provider does not link one from here.
accounts.onboarding.status_cloud: Wuapi Cloud connected, no numbers yet
accounts.onboarding.step1.name: Step 1
accounts.onboarding.step2.name: Step 2
accounts.onboarding.step2.text: Open Linked devices, from the menu or from Settings, and tap Link a device.
accounts.onboarding.step3.name: Step 3
accounts.onboarding.step3.text: Point the phone at the code this window shows.
accounts.onboarding.title: Link your first number
accounts.profile.about_empty: Not shown to this number, or not set.
accounts.profile.about_unknown: WhatsApp did not say what the About text is. What you set here replaces it.
accounts.profile.block_question: Block {name}? They will no longer be able to message or call this number, and will not be told.
accounts.profile.name: Name
accounts.profile.name_unknown: The name on the phone is not known here yet. What you set here replaces it.
accounts.profile.offline: This number is not connected. Changes are sent when it is back.
accounts.profile.picture_question: Remove this number's profile picture on WhatsApp?
accounts.profile.unblock_question: Unblock {name}? They will be able to message and call this number again.
accounts.recovery.lost: Messages waiting to be sent are lost
accounts.recovery.text: It is encrypted, and its key is no longer in your system keychain. Resetting deletes the copy on this computer and downloads your chats again.
accounts.recovery.title: The local database cannot be opened
accounts.settings.account.home_cloud: Wuapi Cloud: stays connected when this computer is off.
accounts.settings.account.home_local: This computer: connected while this application is open.
accounts.settings.account.local_cloud: WhatsApp from this computer, and Wuapi Cloud
accounts.settings.account.note_cloud: Signing out of Wuapi Cloud removes its API key and its numbers' chats from this computer. The numbers linked to this computer stay.
accounts.settings.account.note_demo: Demo data has no account to sign out of.
accounts.settings.account.note_environme: Signed in with WUAPI_API_KEY. Unset it to sign in from here.
accounts.settings.account.note_keychain: Signing out removes the API key and deletes the chats stored on this computer.
accounts.settings.account.note_local: There is no account to sign out of: each number is linked to this computer and is unlinked on its own, under Numbers.
accounts.settings.account.note_offered: Numbers linked to this computer work while this application is open. With Wuapi Cloud a number stays connected when the computer is off.
accounts.settings.account.note_unsaved: Signed in for this session only: the API key is not saved, and the next start asks again.
accounts.settings.appearance.bubbles_tex: The colour of your own messages: a quiet lime tint, the lime itself, or none.
accounts.settings.appearance.motion_text: The logo's animation and the entrances. System follows your desktop's reduced-motion setting; where it has none, motion is on.
accounts.settings.appearance.scale_text: Scales everything together: text, rows, pictures and panes. Ctrl with +, - or 0 does the same from anywhere.
accounts.settings.appearance.wallpaper_t: What is behind the messages: a faint pattern, or the plain page.
accounts.settings.keyboard.text: Everything can be done from the keyboard: the palette goes anywhere and runs any action, with its keys beside it. From the composer, the up arrow goes to the messages; there, single keys act on the message in focus.
accounts.settings.language.text: The language of the interface. System follows your desktop's.
accounts.settings.language.title: Language
accounts.settings.notifications.desktop_: A notification when a message arrives.
accounts.settings.notifications.note: Not delivered yet. This build does not show desktop notifications; your choices are saved and apply when it does.
accounts.settings.notifications.previews: Show the text of the message in the notification.
accounts.settings.server_media.everythin: Server media: everything. Every received file is stored as it arrives.
accounts.settings.server_media.on_demand: Server media: on demand. A file is fetched from WhatsApp when it is first opened.
accounts.settings.server_media.some: Server media: {kinds} up to {size} are stored as they arrive; the rest on demand.
accounts.settings.status.notify_text: A notification when a contact posts a status. Off unless you turn it on; not delivered yet in this build, like the other notifications.
accounts.settings.status.who_sees_edit: Your contacts, your contacts except some of them, or only some of them.
accounts.settings.status.who_sees_none: Not available yet from this provider.
accounts.settings.status.who_sees_read_o: How it is set on your phone. Changing it is not available yet from this provider.
accounts.settings.sync.everything: Every chat is fetched all the way back, in the background. Slow on a large account; search then covers everything.
accounts.settings.sync.media_text: Automatic: everything for numbers on this computer, images through Wuapi Cloud. Up to 25 MB each.
accounts.settings.sync.on_open: The chat list loads on its own. A chat's messages are fetched when you open it, and older ones as you scroll back.
accounts.settings.sync.read_receipts_tex: Tells the other side when you have read their messages. Off: a chat you open is still marked as read on your own devices, without the blue ticks.
accounts.settings.sync.recent: The latest messages of your most recent chats are fetched in the background, so they are there before you open them.
accounts.settings.sync.recent_count_text: Per linked number, the most recent first.
accounts.settings.sync.story_receipts_of: Off while Send read receipts is off: a status you watch is seen here only.
accounts.settings.sync.story_receipts_on: Tells the person who posted a status that you saw it, when it was shown to you. Off: a status you watch is seen here only.
accounts.settings.title: Settings
accounts.updates.no_applications_folder: There is no Applications folder on this system.
accounts.updates.no_build: Version {version} is out, without a build for this system yet.
accounts.updates.no_key: this build has no update key embedded
accounts.updates.off_in_build: Updates are off in this build.
accounts.updates.ready: Version {version} is ready. It is installed when {name} restarts.
accounts.updates.refused: The update could not be used: {reason}. It is asked again later.
accounts.updates.too_old: Version {version} is available. This version is too old to update itself to it: install it from the download page.
accounts.updates.unreachable: The update server could not be reached: {reason}. It is asked again later.
accounts.welcome.choose_text: A provider is what links your WhatsApp numbers to this client.
accounts.welcome.drop_proof_text: Messages queue and go out when the connection is back.
accounts.welcome.native_text: No browser inside. Chats open from this computer, at once.
accounts.welcome.open_source_text: Apache-2.0, with pluggable providers. wuapi is the first.
accounts.welcome.other_providers_text: wuapi is the only adapter today. Writing one is one trait: docs/PROVIDERS.md.
accounts.welcome.provider_text: A hosted WhatsApp API. You sign in from the browser.
accounts.welcome.tagline: A fast, native, open-source WhatsApp client for your wuapi numbers.
